summary: This change adds dedicated shared-app VMs, which run a root-owned gVisor supervisor, and the owner RPCs to install, edit, build and snapshot the app project. F5 is fixed: the stale hostSecurity temp test now matches the rebased stg/471 viewer contract. The source has not changed since round 3, and the import_data temp-then-rename update from that round is sound. All test runs pass, the coverage gate passes with acceptable exemptions, and no findings remain.
